entities.name: EFAIL
entities.gloss: A security vulnerability in email encryption standards allowing the exfiltration of decrypted plaintext.

entities.name: PGP
entities.gloss: A data encryption and decryption program and standard used for signing, encrypting, and decrypting texts and emails.

entities.name: S/MIME
entities.gloss: A standard for public key encryption and signing of MIME data in email systems.

entities.name: Apple Mail
entities.gloss: An email client developed by Apple Inc. for macOS and other operating systems.

entities.name: iOS Mail
entities.gloss: The default email client developed by Apple for iOS mobile devices.

entities.name: Mozilla Thunderbird
entities.gloss: A free and open-source cross-platform email client developed by the Mozilla Foundation.

entities.name: OpenPGP
entities.gloss: An open-standard encryption format based on Pretty Good Privacy used for secure communication.

entities.name: CVE-2017-17688
entities.gloss: A vulnerability identifier for OpenPGP CFB gadget attacks enabling plaintext recovery.

entities.name: CVE-2017-17689
entities.gloss: A vulnerability identifier for S/MIME CBC gadget attacks enabling plaintext recovery.

entities.name: efail.de
entities.gloss: An internet domain hosting research and documentation concerning the EFAIL vulnerability.
